title: Filter media: efficiency, pressure drop and service life
summary: Media choice decides how well a system captures particles and how costly it is to run.
paragraphs: Different filter media offer different efficiency, dust-holding capacity and airflow resistance. Higher efficiency often means higher initial pressure drop, so selection should follow the application — not only the highest class available.
A correctly sized housing and enough media surface extend change-out intervals and cut operating cost. Industrial processes also need to account for temperature, humidity and contaminant type.
Specialist advice helps balance capture, energy use and maintenance frequency.
